sky_direction.meaning: Line of sight from telescope to the sky patch. It is NOT an emission-beam axis or a measurement of propagation farther through a galaxy.

spectral_source_localization.source_bound_evidence: Huberty et al. report the line in stacks A-D spanning two dispersion angles approximately 89 degrees apart, matching one source position and wavelength (16004 +/- 1 Angstrom).
spectral_source_localization.warning: Spectral-line photons received from one direction do not prove a collimated signal or that the line 'continues' through a contiguous track of sky. NIRSpec slitless dispersion produces detector streaks that are not spatial extension of the emitter.

published_MOCSS_same_wavelength_catalog_.source: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.36003v1 ; Huberty et al., MOCSS method paper, Table 1, source IDs MOCSSHUDF1 through MOCSSHUDF23 (the orphan is ID 24).
published_MOCSS_same_wavelength_catalog_.independent_calculation: For every one of the 23 other listed emitters, use its rounded published spectroscopic z and listed Lines of Interest; calculate lambda_observed = lambda_rest*(1+z) for representative strong rest-frame transitions. Compare against 16004 A.
published_MOCSS_same_wavelength_catalog_.what_this_does_not_prove: The 23-object published source catalog is not a blinded, complete same-wavelength spectral map; noncataloged single-line objects, faint secondary transitions, sky background artifacts and sources in other parts of the Universe remain untested.

conditional_distance_scenarios.cosmological_assumption: Approximate flat LCDM: H0=67.66 km/s/Mpc, Omega_m=0.3111, radiation ignored, c=299792.458 km/s. All distances conditional on line ID.
conditional_distance_scenarios.interpretation: Luminosity distance is a flux-distance definition, not photon path length. Lookback years approximate time light has been in transit; proper kpc per arcsec converts *observed angular extent*, which is not yet constrained.

test_design.procedure: From all 16 original GO-3290 exposures, use WCS/MSA shutter mask and grating model to deproject the same 16004 Angstrom wavelength into common RA/Dec coordinates; make independent images for each orientation and each dither, with detector-frame negative controls.
test_design.would_count_as_evidence_for_spatial_exte: Statistically significant surface-brightness distribution wider than the calibrated PSF in both sky-aligned orientations, not following detector dispersion direction.

test_design.procedure: Pre-register aperture grid across at least +/- 5 arcsec around frozen source, search line at 16004+/-10 Angstrom in separate sky apertures, subtract source PSF and local sky, repeat in each orientation, inject fake lines at blank positions, correct for spatial and wavelength trials.
test_design.would_count_as_evidence_for_extended_lin: Independent adjacent apertures with reproducible line flux in both orientations and spatially coherent redshift or velocity gradient.

test_design.procedure: New NIRSpec IFU observation centered at published coordinates plus the three neighboring galaxies; coeval NIRCam F150W imaging; 2D line maps at 16004, 15851 (OIII4959 test), 15539 (Hbeta), around 13655 Angstrom (Pa-gamma under Pa-beta model), plus off-line and off-target nulls. Recompute exact air/vacuum line centers using one convention before requesting observations.
test_design.would_count_as_evidence_for_AGN_illumina: Resolved offset cloud and statistically matched redshift/ionization diagnostics of one neighboring AGN with plausible illumination geometry.

test_design.procedure: Confirm October 2023 between spectral visits and 2025/2026 forced-aperture non-detections with independent PSF aperture correction, injected-source completeness, WHT/ERR checks and exact F150W throughput before physical-model ranking.
test_design.independent_preliminary_evidence: Three 0.12-arcsec-aperture fluxes from direct image pixels are all below 1 sigma in magnitude, as recorded in the companion machine-readable receipt.

physical_hypothesis_priorities_no_probab.unique_spatial_prediction: Line surface brightness offset from adjacent ionizing galaxy; common redshift, velocity/ionization coherence. Persistent cloud requires reconciling middle-epoch imaging.
Compact source with epoch-dependent line, possible underlying host; 2023 October intervening nondetection is a newly relevant temporal falsifier.
Galaxy-sized emission at one of conditional redshifts, characteristic companion line or Lyman break; persistent F150W flux test.
Fails to deproject to same sky morphology and wavelength under alternate reduction, blank shutter controls or injected-line trials.
